news.title: Engineering enzymes with potential against ALS and Parkinson’s disease
news.summary_en: Researchers WashU devised a new high-tech method to generate an enzyme that can break down the misfolded proteins that cause neurodegenerative disease.

news.title: Board grants faculty appointments, tenure
news.summary_en: At the WashU Board of Trustees meeting May 1, a few faculty members were appointed, promoted or granted tenure.

news.title: Model uses real image to train AI to look for fakes
news.summary_en: Nathan Jacobs’ lab at WashU tackles detecting AI-generated images with the real thing.

news.title: Light, genetics provide insight into arrhythmia’s effects on brain
news.summary_en: WashU biomedical engineers used highly sensitive imaging in a mouse model to better understand arrhythmia’s effect on the brain.

news.title: WashU community invited to join Service Saturdays
news.summary_en: WashU Serves has released volunteer dates and locations for Service Saturdays through 2026. These community volunteer days are open to WashU faculty, staff, students, alumni and all other community members.
